messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

Short answer: as automotive radar echo generation moves toward wider instantaneous bandwidth, near-object simulation, more digital channels, and monostatic/bistatic frontend configurations, the VNA measurement task shifts toward wider IF-span coverage, time-domain analysis, fine frequency stepping, narrow measurement bandwidth, and enough dynamic/level accuracy to verify ghost suppression, SFDR, RCS range, and IF transfer behavior.[3][1][2]
- The automotive radar production configurations shown include 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range capability, analog IF interfaces, one to three digital channels depending on configuration, and frontend support for monostatic or bistatic operation.[3]  
- For ghost-object suppression, the VNA is used in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m wanted artificial-object distance, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth.[1]  
- For IF transfer / level measurements, the VNA conditions are 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth.[2]  
- The measured performance targets include spurious-free dynamic range typically greater than 35 dBc or 30 dBc depending on option, and ghost-object suppression greater than 40 dBc.[1]  
- The radar echo generator also specifies dynamic RCS range of 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path, 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path, 0.1 dB RCS control step size, maximum RX IF input power of 10 dBm, recommended RX IF input power of ≤ 0 dBm, maximum TX IF output power of –3 dBm, and IF attenuation accuracy of ±2 dB.[2]
【推論】Therefore, wider-band automotive radar echo-generation setups require the VNA to cover the relevant IF measurement spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz and support time-domain measurement for ghost-object evaluation.[3][1][2]  
【推論】More complex object/channel behavior increases the need for VNA measurements that can verify dynamic range, attenuation accuracy, and small RCS control steps rather than only simple frequency response.[3][2]  
【推論】Because the cited VNA measurement setups specify –10 dBm source power, 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, and defined frequency steps, the required VNA capability is not just high frequency coverage but controlled source level, bandwidth, sweep resolution, and time-domain analysis.[1][2]

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
| 項目 | 條件 | 規格 |
|---|---|---:|
| Spurious free dynamic range | RX IF input to TX IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, measured at –10 dBm signal level, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 30 dBc (typ.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | measured from IF input to IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |

Suppression of ghost objects 量測條件：vector network analyzer in time domain；frequency step size `125 kHz`；measurement bandwidth `100 kHz`；source power `–10 dBm`；distance to wanted artificial object `2 m`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Dynamic RCS range for all artificial objects on one IF path：with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 為 `90 dB`；with [[R&S QAT100]] 為 `> 60 dB`。
- Dynamic RCS range for multiple objects per IF path：with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 為 `60 dB`；with [[R&S QAT100]] 為 `–`。
- RCS control step size：`0.1 dB`。
- Maximum input power at RX IF in connector of AREG800A base unit：`10 dBm (meas.)`。
- Recommended input power at RX IF in：`≤ 0 dBm (meas.)`。
- Maximum output power at TX IF out：`–3 dBm (meas.)`。
- IF attenuation accuracy of AREG800A base unit：`±2 dB (meas.)`。

Vector network analyzer 量測條件：frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，source power `–10 dBm`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。系統由一台 [[R&S ZNA67]] vector network analyzer 與最多四個 external test sets 組成；來源說明規格只對照 R&S ZNA67 rear panel designation scheme 中 type、serial numbers 與正確 port 位置完全一致的 system configuration 有效。

主要產品資訊：

- Impedance：**50 Ω**。
- Test port connector：**1.0 mm, male**。
- Number of test ports：models **.12/.13/.15/.16** 為 **2**；models **.14/.17** 為 **4**。
- Frequency range：**10 MHz to 110 GHz**。
- Frequency resolution：**1 Hz**。
- Number of measurement points：user-selectable **1 to 100001**。
- Measurement bandwidths：**1 Hz to 1.5 MHz**，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 steps。
- Calibration interval：**1 year**。

answer.text:
Short answer: as automotive radar echo generation moves toward wider instantaneous bandwidth, near-object simulation, more digital channels, and monostatic/bistatic frontend configurations, the VNA measurement task shifts toward wider IF-span coverage, time-domain analysis, fine frequency stepping, narrow measurement bandwidth, and enough dynamic/level accuracy to verify ghost suppression, SFDR, RCS range, and IF transfer behavior.[3][1][2]
- The automotive radar production configurations shown include 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, near-object range capability, analog IF interfaces, one to three digital channels depending on configuration, and frontend support for monostatic or bistatic operation.[3]  
- For ghost-object suppression, the VNA is used in time domain with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m wanted artificial-object distance, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth.[1]  
- For IF transfer / level measurements, the VNA conditions are 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth.[2]  
- The measured performance targets include spurious-free dynamic range typically greater than 35 dBc or 30 dBc depending on option, and ghost-object suppression greater than 40 dBc.[1]  
- The radar echo generator also specifies dynamic RCS range of 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path, 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path, 0.1 dB RCS control step size, maximum RX IF input power of 10 dBm, recommended RX IF input power of ≤ 0 dBm, maximum TX IF output power of –3 dBm, and IF attenuation accuracy of ±2 dB.[2]
【推論】Therefore, wider-band automotive radar echo-generation setups require the VNA to cover the relevant IF measurement spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz and support time-domain measurement for ghost-object evaluation.[3][1][2]  
【推論】More complex object/channel behavior increases the need for VNA measurements that can verify dynamic range, attenuation accuracy, and small RCS control steps rather than only simple frequency response.[3][2]  
【推論】Because the cited VNA measurement setups specify –10 dBm source power, 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, and defined frequency steps, the required VNA capability is not just high frequency coverage but controlled source level, bandwidth, sweep resolution, and time-domain analysis.[1][2]
